method: Hand-computed by the author from the CSV rows (independent of the engine). All periods in UTC; ISO weeks start Monday.
notes: Row 6 starts 2026-05-31T23:30-02:00 = 2026-06-01T01:30Z, so it belongs to UTC day 2026-06-01 (timezone boundary case).
Row 9 is a Credit of -20.00 and is included in net totals.
EffectiveCost is empty for rows 3-8 and defaults to BilledCost.
